title: Cloud Ready Web Checks: A Small, Honest Prelaunch Checklist

cover.alt: Conceptual browser tile passing through a prelaunch inspection frame toward an open doorway.

figures.title: Keep the release checks in three places
figures.summary: The checklist works because the steps are written down and share repeatable commands.

items.label: Prelaunch checklist
items.detail: Lists the build, lint, route, interaction, and fallback checks.

items.label: Smoke-check notes
items.detail: Names the few actions to confirm on the deployed URL.

items.label: Package scripts
items.detail: Provide a consistent command for build and lint.

figures.caption: The three repository artifacts described in the article, shown by responsibility.

figures.title: From local checks to a verified release
figures.summary: A successful local run is one stage of the release, not the final proof.

items.label: Deploy
items.detail: Publish the checked build through the normal deployment path.

items.label: Smoke check
items.detail: Open the real URL and exercise the main action, important interaction, and fallback route.

items.label: Record
items.detail: Note what changed, what was verified, and any checks skipped.

figures.caption: A release sequence drawn from this post. It does not claim that a build alone proves the deployed system works.
